optimizedContext.value:
# runIndexProjectGraph

## Rules

- `runIndexProjectGraph(ctx: SdkHostContext, input: RunIndexProjectGraphInput): Promise<RunIndexProjectGraphResult>` orchestrates SDK graph indexing.
- Validate lifecycle first: if `input.provider` and either `input.beforeOpen` or `input.afterClose` exist, throw `InvalidProviderLifecycleError`, a `SpecdError` with `code: 'INVALID_PROVIDER_LIFECYCLE'`.
- Resolve `SpecdConfig` through `ctx.kernel.project.getConfig.execute()`; call `ctx.kernel.project.listWorkspaces.execute()`; prepare `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, `graphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`, `vcsRef`, `force`, `onProgress`.
- `input.workspaces` MAY restrict targets; omission indexes all configured workspaces.
- Provided `input.provider`: require already-open `CodeGraphProvider`; invoke `createIndexProjectGraph()` directly with provider; MUST NOT close provider after success/failure.
- Omitted provider: execute inside `withOpenGraphProvider(ctx, async (provider) => { ... }, { beforeOpen: input.beforeOpen, afterClose: input.afterClose })`; invoke `createIndexProjectGraph()` on transient opened provider; close transient provider on completion.
- Repair lifecycle: when old schema cannot open for normal reads, carry incompatibility-repair intent and full-rebuild results without lossy mapping using indexing repair path. Preserve provider ownership of destructive recreation.
- `acquireGraphIndexLock` MUST NOT run inside orchestration. CLI adapters MAY acquire subprocess lock through `beforeOpen` passed to `withOpenGraphProvider`.
- Forward `input.onProgress` events from `IndexProjectGraph` unchanged.
- `RunIndexProjectGraphResult` MUST preserve all `IndexProjectGraph` result fields, including indexed file/symbol counts, per-workspace breakdown, errors; no lossy mapping.

## Constraints

- External provider lifecycle belongs to caller; transient provider lifecycle belongs to `withOpenGraphProvider`.
- Concurrent-index lock acquisition remains host/CLI concern.
- Progress and result data pass through without transformation.
